item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q002_mazg_hise_remote_homology","answer":"SCOPe 2.08 supports remote homology—common evolutionary ancestry—between these domains at the superfamily level. d1vmga_ (SUNID 113676) belongs to the MazG-like family a.204.1.2, whereas d1y6xa1 (SUNID 122676; chain A residues 7–93) belongs to the HisE-like (PRA-PH) family a.204.1.4. Both fall within the all-alpha NTP pyrophosphatases superfamily a.204.1 (SUNID 101386), whose homology record explicitly implies homology. They also share fold a.204 and the all-alpha class a, but fold or class membership alone would not establish common ancestry. Their separate families do not establish close sequence similarity or orthology.\n\nSCOPe describes a shared active-site architecture involving five helices, four contributed by one subunit or structural repeat and one by another. This supports a conserved structural framework, not identical biochemical specificity. d1vmga_ is classified under a hypothetical Sulfolobus solfataricus protein; d1y6xa1 is annotated as Mycobacterium tuberculosis phosphoribosyl-ATP pyrophosphatase HisE. Transferring HisE's specific substrate and histidine-biosynthesis role to d1vmga_, or assigning MazG-like nucleotide specificity or physiological roles to d1y6xa1, would exceed the classification evidence. Identical catalytic residues, metal requirements, kinetics, oligomeric organization, or functional interchangeability likewise cannot be assumed. Such claims require independent sequence and active-site comparisons, ligand/metal and assembly evidence, biochemical substrate-specificity measurements, and physiological or genetic evidence for pathway roles. A shared superfamily can guide structural comparison or template selection, but does not guarantee an accurate substrate-bound active-site model.","evidence_used":["Pretrained knowledge of SCOPe hierarchy and limits of functional inference","mcp__scope__get_scop_domains","mcp__scope__get_scop_node","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1vmga_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1vmga_/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1y6xa1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1y6xa1/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/101386","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/101386/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/101386/homology"]}]}
